run_faiss_vs_scann_benchmark: run a benchmark comparing FAISS and SCANN ANN search performance on a dataset
run_faiss_eval_search: run FAISS IVF search evaluation with configurable nprobe and reorder values
run_scann_eval_search: run SCANN search evaluation with tree-based clustering and anisotropic quantization
build_faiss_ivf_index: build a FAISS IVF2000 PQ index trained on database vectors and save to disk
build_scann_index: build a SCANN searcher with tree clustering and optional reordering, then serialize to disk
